shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,110p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n---PROJECT---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n---TRAPS---\\n' && rg -n -C 4 'Typography|Button|ThemeProvider|Flex|theming|Button view' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && printf '\\n---APP---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n---MAIN---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n---CSS---\\n' && cat src/index.css"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Checkbox Button ThemeProvider && rg -n -C 3 'TextInput|Checkbox|styles.css|ThemeProvider|Provider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Checkbox Button ThemeProvider; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg 'docs/INDEX|README.md|textinput|checkbox|button|provider|theme' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'TextInput|Checkbox|Button|ThemeProvider|styles.css|fonts.css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -180 && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'fullWidth|width|type\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'typography|header-1|header-2|body-1|--g-color-base-background|--g-color-text-primary|--g-color-base-float' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -90 && cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -- '--g-color-(base-background|base-generic|base-float|line-generic|text-primary|text-secondary|text-hint|text-light-primary|sfx-shadow)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles | head -80 && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css index.html package.json | head -230"
/bin/bash -lc "npm run build && node -e \"require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})\""
